meta.name: add-ollama-tool
meta.description: Add Ollama MCP server so the container agent can call local models and optionally manage the Ollama model library.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器 agent 调用本地大模型并管理模型库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在容器中运行本地大模型并管理模型库
copy.tagline_en: Enable container agent to call local models and manage model library
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run local LLMs in containers and manage model libraries

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可通过 Ollama MCP 工具调用本机模型：列出已安装模型、向指定模型发送提示并获取回复；若启用管理工具，还可拉取、删除、查看模型详情和运行中的模型。
howto.when: 当用户要求用 Ollama 处理任务（如“用 Ollama 告诉我法国的首都”），或请求管理模型（如“拉取 gemma3:1b”）时触发。

say.text: 用 Ollama 告诉我法国的首都
say.note: Claude 会先列出模型，再生成回答。
仅启用管理工具时可用。

say.text: 哪些 Ollama 模型当前在内存中？

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use the Ollama MCP tools to call local models: list installed models, send prompts to specific models and get responses. If management tools are enabled, it can also pull, delete, inspect models, and list running ones.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to use Ollama for a task (e.g., 'use Ollama to tell me the capital of France') or requests model management (e.g., 'pull gemma3:1b').

say_en.text: Use Ollama to tell me the capital of France
say_en.note: Claude will list models first, then generate an answer.
Only available if management tools are enabled.

say_en.text: Which Ollama models are currently loaded in memory?
